name: RMD-MP
savepath: This is an update bringing Halloween Havoc and the return of The Mad King to Remodded as well as much needed bug fixes and additions, we apologize for our time constraints and hope you enjoy the event!

Pandemonium is here! D2RLan/Launch has been rebuilt from the ground up and a new 2.4/3.X integrated format for a seamless, streamlined addition to our modding toolbox. It allows players to play on multiple game modes of D2R, with any mod, with one-click mod updates, new hardcoded features and more.
